name: Mintlify search MCP server
summary: Mintlify generates and hosts a search MCP server for every documentation site on its platform, at the /mcp path of that site's URL, and advertises it in four auto-generated discovery documents. Measured keyless on 2026-10-07, one request per probe record: initialize, tools/list, resources/list, a search and a filesystem ls each answered 200 with no account, the search returning ten source-cited passages in 1.04 s. Three tools, one of them not read-only and absent from the server cards. Every discovery document read names a mintlify.me hostname rather than the domain serving it.
license: Hosted under Mintlify's Terms of Service

agentAccess.notes: Keyless 2026-10-07 on www.mintlify.com/docs/mcp: initialize, tools/list, resources/list, a search and a filesystem ls each answered 200 with no Authorization header, no session id and no preceding initialize. The vendor gates only sites that use authentication, at /authed/mcp.

payments.notes: Read 2026-10-06, re-measured 2026-10-07: no keyless request drew a 402 and no vendor page read names a machine-payment protocol. The pricing page's Starter tier renders $0/mo with the MCP server row Included, Pro $450/mo, Enterprise on contact. No page says how a paid plan is charged.

jobs.summary: The vendor's words: the server lets an AI application 'search your content and retrieve full pages as Markdown' so it 'uses up-to-date information from your site', searching 'your current indexed content directly'. Keyless 2026-10-07: ten source-cited passages in 1.04 s, five on the question.
